# Andrii Pavlov

> Andrii Pavlov is a penetration tester based in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, with 12+ years in cybersecurity and 6 years in offensive security. He tests applications and web platforms, mobile apps on iOS and Android, and internal infrastructure. Web and API testing follows OWASP Top 10, ASVS and WSTG; mobile testing follows MASTG on both platforms (data storage, TLS and certificate pinning, jailbreak and root detection, deep links, Keychain and Keystore); internal work covers Active Directory, Windows and Linux hosts, service enumeration, privilege escalation, pivoting and tunneling. He has experience leading penetration testing teams and managing a security team (most recently at Royal Bank of Canada, and earlier at TechCom Services), and has delivered 380+ penetration tests, 200+ application and vendor assessments and identified 4,000+ vulnerabilities. OSCP candidate. Open to Penetration Tester, Application Security and Penetration Testing Team Lead roles in Canada.

## Key Facts

- Current role: Senior Application Security Analyst, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Vancouver, BC, since June 2025; leads a penetration testing team.
- Previous roles: Offensive Security Specialist at Cyberoo (Nov 2023 – Jun 2025); Penetration Tester at H-X Technologies (Dec 2020 – Oct 2023); Cyber Security Analyst at TechCom Services LLC (Jan 2014 – Dec 2020), where he managed a security team.
- Volume: 380+ penetration tests, 200+ application and vendor security assessments at RBC, 80+ engagements at Cyberoo, 100+ tests at H-X Technologies, 4,000+ vulnerabilities identified, and red team exercises simulating advanced persistent threats.
- Engagement ownership: scoping and rules of engagement, test planning, QA of findings, CVSS scoring, executive reporting and retesting, end to end.
- Outcomes: 75% reduction in client risk exposure, 40% reduction in attack surface, 100% ISO 27001 and GDPR compliance across 50+ audits, 1,000+ employees trained.
- Specialisms: application and web penetration testing (web apps, single-page apps, REST and GraphQL APIs, business logic, access control, injection classes); mobile penetration testing on iOS and Android (MASTG, MASVS, OWASP Mobile Top 10, Frida, MobSF, Objection, pinning and root detection bypass); internal infrastructure penetration testing (Active Directory, Windows and Linux hosts, service enumeration, local and domain privilege escalation, lateral movement, pivoting and tunneling, password attacks); plus threat modeling, secure code review, SAST/DAST/SCA, WAF tuning, CVSS risk rating and remediation validation. Red team depth in Active Directory attack paths and MITRE ATT&CK-mapped adversary simulation (BloodHound, SharpHound, Cobalt Strike, Brute Ratel).
- Certifications: OSCP (candidate, exam scheduled), Cisco Ethical Hacker, ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC), TCM Security practical certifications (API hacking, ethical hacking, malware analysis and triage, bug bounty, mobile app penetration testing), Cybrary Offensive Penetration Testing, LinkedIn Learning NIST RMF.
- Education: Master of Business Administration, National Aviation University, Kyiv, Ukraine, 2007–2013.
- Contact: pavlov.andrii@gmail.com, +1 587 896 8118, Vancouver, BC, Canada.
